T2.5.title: World maps
T2.5.summary: The game world unpacked into loadable maps (README.md): the overworld (regions 0-7 stitched, 2048x1024 tiles), 62 building interiors, 5 dungeons and the astral plane, each cut from the shared indoor sheet by walking from its doors (fmain.c:1919-1927, 1944-1950, 1784-1789; px_to_im/prox fsubs.asm:548-614, 1590-1611). Every map ships tiles.png (8-bit: original tile id in its tileset region) and master.png (16-bit: master atlas index, which also carries collision) plus a preview rendered from the real tiles with entry points ringed in magenta. Review by looking at the previews: each should be a complete, recognisable place with its entrance where you remember it; nothing from a neighbouring building should bleed in.

items.title: maps.json — 69 maps
items.look_for: One row per map: overworld, astral plane, 5 dungeons (dragon cave, maze caves, spider pit, tombs, troll cave; region 9), 62 interiors (region 8). The entries column names the doors that lead into each; desert fort has 4 (identical doorlist rows), crystal palace 2, doom tower lists the stargate's return trip, spider pit lists the quicksand drop, cabins list their yard doors.

items.title: Overworld — 2048x1024 tiles, regions F1-F8 stitched
items.look_for: The whole continent at 1/4 scale (8192x8192): snowfield top-left, witch wood top-right, swamp and dark forest left of centre, Tambry's roads and the plains in the middle, the Burning Waste desert and the volcanic waste with lava bottom-left, Marheim's grey castle with the orange farm grid on the bay, the mountain ridges of the south-east. No seams or misaligned strips where the eight regions meet (rows 256/512/768, column 1024). Tiny magenta rings sit on every door (zoom in on Tambry or Marheim) and one on the quicksand cell north-east of Tambry.

items.title: Dungeons — tombs, dragon cave, maze caves, spider pit, troll cave (region 9 tileset)
items.look_for: Five separate cave systems in dark dungeon stone, each one connected piece with black outside. Tombs: the long left corridor linking the winding passages at the top, the square grid maze and the lower-left block complex; one ring at the stair entrance. Dragon cave: the big system with its wide room complex on the right. Maze caves: the two maze entrances both ring the same system. Spider pit: two rings — the cave-mouth exit and the quicksand drop point inside. Troll cave: a small cave. Secret doors appear as plain wall segments; nothing from the villages or the astral plane is left inside the boxes.

items.title: Astral plane — 212x68, via the doom-tower stargate
items.look_for: A large blue starfield rectangle (the extent 0x2400-0x3100 x 0x8200-0x8a00) with the stargate landing ringed. The doom tower preview shows both its door and the stargate return point (two rings); the stargate sits inside the tower, not in any cave.

items.title: Castles and palaces — main castle, witch's castle, crystal palace, mammoth manor, elf glade, unreachable castle
items.look_for: Main castle (Marheim): grey walls around green courtyards and two red-carpet throne rooms, door ringed on the right. Witch's castle: dark stone keep. Crystal palace: blue crystal halls, two rings at its double door. Mammoth manor: a long low hall. Elf glade: a walled garden. Unreachable castle: a small stone hall. Each is one building with black around it.

items.title: Keeps — 7 stone keeps (17x10) and 5 marble keeps (14x8)
items.look_for: Two families of near-identical floor plans (the keeps share sector layouts): seven HSTONE keeps and five MARBLE keeps, each a single walled hall with its door ringed at the bottom. Furnishing differs slightly between them.

items.title: Forts and inns — plain/gate/pass fort, desert fort, forest/road's end/friendly inn
items.look_for: Three small black-stone forts (10x7) with one ring each; the desert fort with its four coincident rings (one per doorlist row); three identical inn floor plans (17x11) with beds and tables, door ringed at the bottom.

items.title: Cabins #1-#10 (12x9 each)
items.look_for: Ten log cabins: an orange-floored one-room cabin with a bed, each with a fenced yard. Cabin and yard are one map, two rings each: the yard gate and the cabin door. Cabins 4, 5 and 9 get their gates by correction — the source table sends those gates into cabins 7, 8 and 6 (source bug, PROBLEMS.md P27; the original values are kept in map.json entries[].fix).

items.title: Oases #1-#5, swamp shack, light house, crypt
items.look_for: Five desert oasis interiors (small walled courtyards, DESERT doors), the swamp shack, the light house (a tiny 8x8 room) and the crypt (8x6). One ring each.

items.title: Tambry — village #1-#8
items.look_for: Eight small wooden village houses (orange floors, beds, tables). Village #1 has two rings (doors 1.a and 1.b open into the same house). Adjacent houses on the indoor sheet are cut apart: no second house inside a box.

items.title: Marheim — city #10-#19
items.look_for: Ten stone city houses, several only 3x2 tiles of floor. City #15 has two rings (doors 15.a and 15.b). The houses sit wall-to-wall on the indoor sheet; each map holds exactly one house with shared walls kept and the neighbour's floor blanked.

items.title: Index layers — tiles.png / master.png (crypt)
items.look_for: The two layers are tiny greyscale images the size of the map in tiles (8x6): tiles.png is dark (values 0-255), master.png near-black (values up to ~970 of 65535). They are data, not pictures — the preview is what they render to. tools/decode_map_layers.py assets/maps/interiors/crypt --dump csv prints both as numbers.
